title: Look back at the week
pitch: About 2 minutes. Looking back on purpose shows you progress you'd otherwise miss, and turns one hard moment into something to try next week.

cards.prompt: About 2 minutes. Looking back on purpose shows you progress you'd otherwise miss, and turns one hard moment into something to try next week.
How do you feel right now?
cards.why: A number now gives you a baseline to compare with next week.

cards.prompt: What went well this week, even something small?
cards.why: Small wins are easy to forget, and noticing them shows you what's working.
options: I kept my cool when it was hard
We had a good evening together
I said what I needed instead of hinting
I did something just for me

cards.why: Picking one moment keeps it specific enough to learn from.

cards.prompt: What's one thing you want to try next week?
cards.why: One small, clear step is far more likely to happen than a big plan.
options: Take a breath before I reply
Plan one evening just for us
Say what I need out loud
Go to bed a bit earlier

cards.prompt: How do you feel right now?
cards.why: Comparing with the start shows you what looking back did.
